name: web-search-skill
description: Searches the web for current facts, general knowledge, and 'look it up' questions, then answers in plain spoken language.

intents.description: Search the internet to answer a factual or general-knowledge question, or when the user explicitly asks to look something up or search online.
example_utterances: Search the web for the tallest mountain in the world
Look up who won the cricket world cup in 2011
What is the capital of Australia?
Search for how tall the Eiffel Tower is
